summary: Show served mission-run ETA on mission rows and the Missions screen

schema.detail: Consumes the existing optional mission-run ETA served by the client schema.

compatibility.detail: Absent ETA from older daemons and null ETA render no extra content. Finished runs never show an ETA. Remaining durations are displayed as served, relative to the as_of publication time; only observation age is relative, with no browser countdown or timing-derived estimate.
